dataset: INSPIRE-AVR Extended Clinical Archive (99 Verified Cases from 100 Archive Folders)
provenance_note: Extracted from data-assets/INSPIRE_AVR/INSPIRE_AVR.zip containing 100 case directories (IM000001..IM006106). Directory IM000189 is empty in the raw archive, yielding 99 complete clinical cases. Archive filename typos in 7 cases (including IM000001--artry.jpg and IM000001/IM000168--veins.jpg verified at 99.86% vessel pixel intersection with IM000001--vessels.jpg) were normalized to canonical {case_id}--arteries.jpg and {case_id}--veins.jpg.
iowa_reference_discrepancy_explanation: The official Iowa Normative Set reference paper (Niemeijer et al.) cites 40 images measured by medical experts for benchmark evaluation. The local archive in data-assets/INSPIRE_AVR expands this to 100 patient folders (99 non-empty). The provided --arteries.jpg and --veins.jpg files are binary rasterizations of Adobe Illustrator (.ai) vector tracings created for vessel branch identification, not clinical numeric measurement tables. Consequently, in strict compliance with Principle D6 (Scientific Truthfulness), the raster masks are used for automated vs ground-truth vessel branch classification and centerline caliber estimation, while true clinical gold-standard AVR measurement validation remains marked as AWAITING_QUANTITATIVE_IOWA_REFERENCE_TABLE.
